questions.prompt: Which US amendment gave women the right to vote?
questions.fact: It passed by a single vote in the Tennessee legislature, cast by a man persuaded by a letter from his mother.

questions.prompt: What is the term for organisms that make their own food?
questions.fact: Some do it with chemicals rather than light, living around deep-sea vents where sunlight never reaches.

questions.prompt: In football, what is the maximum number of substitutes usually allowed in a competitive match?
questions.fact: It rose from three to five in 2020 as a temporary measure for congested schedules, and was then made permanent.

questions.prompt: Which film features a character called Ferris Bueller?
questions.fact: The parade scene was filmed during a real Chicago festival, and most of the crowd had no idea a film was being made.

questions.prompt: Which country lies immediately north of Denmark?
questions.fact: Denmark's only land border is with Germany to the south; Norway and Sweden are across water.

questions.prompt: Which novel features the character Tom Joad?
questions.fact: His closing speech has been set to music by several songwriters, most famously Bruce Springsteen.

questions.prompt: What does the acronym P2P describe?
questions.fact: BitTorrent works by having downloaders simultaneously upload, so popular files transfer faster rather than slower.
